messages:
alex: FYI starting cross-service cutover in 20m UTC (router + runtime + api + console). change window 20-60m. plan: staggered canaries, no auto-rollover. please ack and stand by :mega:
priya: ack. I'll own api rollout and release notes. publishing note now: https://go/release/1746 - includes console header opt-in and router fallback behavior.
matt: I'll do runtime canary. switching to `v3.0.0-quant` on 6 hosts first. kernel tweak enabled. pinning variant for canary only.
laura: console patch ready. it respects `X-RW-SPLIT` and has feature gate `console.split-routing`. smoke tests queued.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued for 2026-03-22T16:00:00Z. Sequence: router(canary)->runtime(canary)->api->console. Canary windows: 5m@5%, 10m@25%, then ramp. Runbook: /runbooks/cutover-1746.
ops-bot: baseline snapshots taken: perf/1746129999. alerts routed to #incidents.
alex: Rollback thresholds proposal: api p95 > 500ms OR errors > 1% over 5m => abort. runtime p99 > 650ms OR 5xx spike > 0.8% => abort. manual only rollback flag set.
matt: adding KV eviction watch - abort if kv miss rate jumps >12% in two consecutive minutes. I'll add a sticky metric on dashboard.
priya: API note - clients must tolerate `429` for 2-3 mins during final ramp. I'll add a short blurb to release notes.
laura: smoke tests passed 44d console will accept `X-RW-SPLIT: true`. keeping backward compat.
deploy-bot: Canary kicked off - router at 5% (header-split enabled), runtime variant `v3.0.0-quant` on 6 hosts.
matt: seeing runtime p99 ~380ms, error 0.1%. safe to bump runtime to 25% now.
priya: router canary healthy. moving api canary to 25% now. watch for tail latency.
ops-bot: alert check: no new incidents. synthetic checks green.
alex: Reminder: no schema migration in this cutover. console header is opt-in. If console fails, router will keep legacy routing.
priya: API at 25% for 10m. p95 210ms, errors 0.15%. continuing.
laura: console integration tests: load path OK, small header parsing warning (non-blocking).
matt: runtime p99 climbed to 590ms during a short GC but recovered. staying at 25% for now. will watch KV misses.
alex: If runtime p99 > 700ms for two samples or 5xx spike > 1% -> immediate abort and rollback to `v2.9.8`. ops, be ready with `deploy-bot rollback --service runtime --to v2.9.8`.
priya: API steady. prepping final ramp notes in release doc.
deploy-bot: Full ramp started: moving from canary slices to staged 50% -> 100% over 10m. Auto-rollback disabled; manual commands available.
matt: KV miss rate trending up to 9% but under abort threshold. watching.
ops-bot: health ping: api-lb healthy, router nodes stable. tail-latency trending +5%.
laura: small console error burst 1.2% for 2m (parsing warnings) - not 5xx. leaning no rollback. tagging the incident for follow-up.
alex: decision: continue but hold final 100% ramp for 5m. if console errors escalate to >2% convert to rollback.
priya: publishing release notes now and flagging clients about header opt-in. https://go/release/1746#notes
matt: runtime at 50% now. p99 410ms, errors 0.18%.
deploy-bot: Roll complete for router/runtime/api/console at 16:46 UTC. Please file any post-cutover followups in #eng-releases.\alex: thanks team. will do a quick postmortem if any followups. :tada:
